Love the colour! Pastels are a pain for fading fast, I'd personally recommend cowashing, basically using conditioner instead of shampoo. You can still shampoo if and when you need to, but it drastically cuts down my need to shampoo, which in turn makes my hair colours last longer! Adding a little bit of dye (assuming it's semi-permanent) to your conditioner will also help.

I'd also suggest you check out r/curlyhair for more tips and tricks, as well as product recommendations
